thread:
mia: Hey team, inbound SI asks about air-gapped onboarding for private deploys. They need a clear assessment flow, hardware acceptance criteria, and how we issue certs when telemetry is limited. Any existing playbook? :thinking_face:
ben: We have a basic doc but it's scattered. Key constraints: no outbound telemetry, offline KMS key exchange, and signed manifests for images. We should define an "airgap assessment checklist".
tara: Agree. Suggest sections: preflight paperwork (SLA, risk ack), network topology review, HW compatibility & burn-in, offline package delivery, acceptance testing, cert issuance.
lin: For certs, we can gate Bronze (self-verified) vs Silver (Redwood-assisted onsite or remote with screen-share) vs Gold (Redwood-run pilot). For airgap, Silver should require recorded acceptance tests + signed manifest.
ben: Also need to handle security reviews: signed SBOM, signed kernel/module lists, and proof of HW acceptance (burn-in logs). If telemetry is disabled, require periodic manual report uploads.
mia: Good. Can we draft a minimal YAML checklist that intake/PS/partner can use? Make it easy to embed in the marketplace intake.
lin: Draft below:
```yaml
airgap_assessment_checklist:
  paperwork:
    - sla_signed: true
    - nda_signed: true
    - risk_ack: partner_initials_required
  network:
    - allowed_internal_endpoints: [list provided]
    - no_outbound_egress: true
  hardware:
    - sku_compatibility: checked
    - burn_in_hours: 48
    - nvme_health_ok: true
  package_delivery:
    - image_manifest_signed: true
    - sbom_attached: true
    - offline_kms_procedure: documented
  acceptance_tests:
    - deploy_smoke_test: pass
    - perf_baseline: within_threshold
    - security_scan: critical=0
  certs:
    - bronze: auto_if_all_checks_pass
    - silver: require_acceptance_report
    - gold: require_pilot_sla
```
tara: That looks solid. For "offline_kms_procedure" we need a standard HSM handoff template + import script. Security will need to approve.
lin: If partners refuse any logs, Silver should mandate a remote witness session where we observe live tests. Document timeboxed windows (2 hours).
ben: Also include acceptance window: partner has 14 days post-delivery to complete burn-in and upload signed logs. After that, a 7-day extension can be requested.
security-bot: Heads up: security requires SBOM signed with build metadata and reproducible build proof for air-gapped images. See policy: https://redwood.internal/sec/airgap-policy.
mia: Action items: 1) Tara to add import script & HSM template; 2) Lin to write remote witness playbook; 3) Ben to add acceptance window rules to marketplace intake; 4) Security to confirm SBOM format. I'll make a Confluence stub and link.
tara: I'll draft HSM handoff and a short video clip showing import steps. ETA Tue.
lin: Remote witness playbook draft: schedule 2-hr window; SE runs smoke + perf; partner shares console; we capture signed acceptance note. I'll post draft by Wed.
ben: Marketplace intake flags to add: "airgap_required", "offline_kms", "burn_in_hours", "signed_sbom". Also telemetry tag guidance: if telemetry off, include manual_report_upload_url.
ops-bot: Created ticket REDWOOD-SI-4501: "Airgap onboarding checklist + marketplace intake fields" -> https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-4501
security-bot: Noted. I'll coordinate SBOM schema and sample signed manifest with build team.
mia: Last Q: logos/marketing for air-gapped SIs. Do we allow public listing? maybe Bronze visible only in partner directory, Silver+ on marketplace. Thoughts?
tara: Keep conservative: only Silver+ on public marketplace. Bronze in private partner directory. Also include "is_airgap_eligible" flag.
lin: Suggest we add a hidden metadata field for audit: "acceptance_evidence_ids" that can store fingerprinted hashes of signed manifests. Ops/billing can use it.
ben: Good call. I'll add that to the intake PR.
mia: Thanks all. I'll post the Confluence link and ping for legal sign-off. Pilot this flow with 1 SI next month. :rocket:
